description: This file defines the VocabularyListBuilder class for building and rendering a list of taxonomy vocabularies in Drupal, including operations, headers, rows, and form handling.

classes.name: VocabularyListBuilder
classes.description: A class that builds and manages the listing of taxonomy vocabulary entities in Drupal, providing operations, headers, rows, and form handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the VocabularyListBuilder with dependencies such as current user, entity type manager, renderer, and messenger.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of VocabularyListBuilder using dependency injection container.

methods.name: getFormId
methods.description: Returns the form ID for the vocabulary overview.

methods.name: getDefaultOperations
methods.description: Provides default operations (edit, delete, list, add) for a vocabulary entity, with access checks.

methods.name: buildHeader
methods.description: Builds the header row for the vocabulary list table, including label, description, and optionally weight.

methods.name: buildRow
methods.description: Builds a table row for a given vocabulary entity, including label and description.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the vocabulary list, handling cache dependencies and empty state messages.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form for managing vocabularies, including attributes and submit button.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, displaying a status message.
